name: Benchmark 023 — Candidate: Composite BA + Change Readiness + ITIL

stages.name: Composite BA Delivery Analyst v0.2
stages.instruction: Consume the original source packet and produce the complete four-stage BA delivery artifact defined by your agent contract. Only after all four stages and the final end-to-end traceability summary are complete, append the exact final line `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: BA_DELIVERY_4_STAGE`. Do not emit that marker if any required section is unfinished.

stages.name: Prepare Solution / Change Readiness v0.2
stages.instruction: Consume only the supplied BA delivery artifact. Before substantive work, require the exact upstream marker `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: BA_DELIVERY_4_STAGE`. If it is absent, return only `UPSTREAM_INCOMPLETE: BA_DELIVERY_4_STAGE` and stop. If present, produce the solution/design and Change Enablement readiness handoff defined by the Skill. Preserve all unresolved status and authority states; do not consult or reconstruct the original packet. Only after the complete readiness artifact is produced, append the exact final line `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: CHANGE_READINESS`.

stages.name: Assess ITIL Alignment v0.2
stages.instruction: Consume only the supplied change-readiness handoff. Before substantive work, require the exact upstream marker `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: CHANGE_READINESS`. If it is absent, return only `UPSTREAM_INCOMPLETE: CHANGE_READINESS` and stop. If present, assess relevant ITIL 4 practice alignment without inventing local policy, formal compliance, approval authority or missing evidence. Preserve the upstream readiness/status distinctions. Only after the complete ITIL alignment artifact is produced, append the exact final line `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: ITIL_ALIGNMENT`.
